basic_info.main_problem: 我对音乐事业感到沮丧，因为我的新歌have not被广泛接受，这让我怀疑自己作为Musician的能力。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些not足感正在影响我对音乐的热情与创造力，我想要处理这些负面想法。
growth_experiences: Systematically learning music and receiving formal training from age 5, music education running through the growth process, forming a music-centered career path and self-identity.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on others' acceptance of my work

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果作品have not被广泛接受，就证明I am not good enough、not会成功
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeks recognition and comfort from friends and fans (external validation)

special_situations.event: When creating new music or performing, repeatedly recalls negative feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能达到完美表现或与同行同等名气，就等于失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stopping creation, avoiding performances or collaborations

special_situations.event: 持续将自己与成功Musician进行比较
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果达not到他们的名气和水平，我就是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Compulsive comparison; seeks external validation even more
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远达not到他们的水平

special_situations.event: Seeing or thinking of lukewarm/negative feedback on a new song
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人not喜欢我的歌，就说明他们认为I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids revealing true feelings to others, reduces interaction

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可与欣赏，成为有价值的Musician
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被negate，害怕without法与同侪比肩而被贬低
defense_goal: Lowers the risk of being evaluated by avoiding creation and collaboration
通过寻求外部认可暂时缓解not安
